name: Multi-Resolution Dual Marching Cubes with Manifold Preservation
aliases: Dual Surface Extraction on Generalized Octrees
definition: A method to generate multi-resolution, closed manifold surfaces from segmented volumetric data by extending Dual Marching Cubes over a generalized octree, using a cell-based criterion to prevent non-manifold configurations.
summary: Multi-Resolution Dual Marching Cubes with Manifold Preservation is a top-down surface extraction method that generates closed manifold meshes from volumetric data without post-processing, unlike standard Dual Marching Cubes.
